title: Globalisation

blocks.heading: Globalisation
blocks.text: Globalisation is increasing international connectedness and interdependence through flows such as trade, investment, information and people. It differs from global warming, a rise in global average temperature. Communication can support globalisation but does not by itself establish fair access.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Use the evidence
blocks.text: An invented design business shares plans with a foreign workshop and coordinates orders across several countries. These links illustrate globalisation through connected production, communication and exchange. They are conceptually different from a change in global average temperature. A cross-border link does not itself establish the scale or distribution of local development benefits.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated
